layout.arrangement: No title bar. Top band split into three blocks: left sample matrix, centre weight/step/legend, right 'Check classes of' test-vector matrix. Middle-left holds the augmented-vectors matrix above a solid red 'Check Classes' box. The right two-thirds from middle to bottom carry three stacked decision rows (d(Z₁), d(Z₂), d(Z₃)) each ending in a colour-coded class tag. Slide number '51' sits in a yellow circle at the extreme top-right. A thin border frames the whole slide.

layout.hierarchy: Solid-fill elements dominate first: the red 'Check Classes' box and the yellow '51' circle. Next, the three d(Z) rows command the right side through size and the ⇒/→ arrows. Colour coding creates the semantic hierarchy: red = Class I / positive / C₁, blue = Class II / negative / undefined / C₂, black = neutral data. Matrices are visually quiet (thin black text, no fills).

imagery: Mouse-pointer cursor icon (black with white outline) next to the 'Undefined Class' tag; no photographs or illustrations otherwise.
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout (Arial/Calibri-like). Subscripts are true lowered numerals (₁ ₂ ₃) on x, C, Z and inside d(Zₙ). 'Step' is italic red. Matrix cells wrap each number in parentheses. d(Zₙ) labels are blue; class tags are colour-coded (Class I red, Class II and Undefined Class blue). No all-caps text. The red 'Check Classes' box uses white bold-looking text on solid red.
